We will post the revised privacy policy on the Site, update the "Last updated" date and take any other steps required by applicable law.
confidentialite.howWeCollectTitle: How we collect and use your personal information
confidentialite.howWeCollectText1: To provide the Services, we collect and have collected over the past 12 months personal information about you from various sources, as set out below. The information we collect and use varies depending on how you interact with us.

confidentialite.personalInfoText: The types of personal information we obtain about you depend on how you interact with our Site and use our Services. When we use the term "personal information", we mean information that identifies, relates to, describes or can be associated with you.
confidentialite.directInfoTitle: Information we collect directly from you

To do this, we may use cookies, pixels and similar technologies ("Cookies"). confidentialite.thirdPartyInfoTitle: Information we obtain from third parties
confidentialite.thirdPartyInfoText: Finally, we may obtain information about you from third parties, including from vendors and service providers who may collect information on our behalf, such as:
thirdPartyInfoItems: Companies that support our Site and Services, such as Shopify.

confidentialite.providingServicesText: We use your personal information to provide the Services to you, to perform the contract we have with you, including to process your payments, fulfill your orders, send you notifications about your account, your purchases, returns, exchanges or other transactions.
confidentialite.marketingText: We may use your personal information for marketing and promotional purposes, for example to send marketing, advertising and promotional communications by email, SMS or postal mail, and to show you ads for products or services.

confidentialite.cookiesText2: Most browsers accept cookies automatically by default, but you can choose to set your browser to remove or reject cookies using your browser controls.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how Renaissance Eyewear uses cookies and similar technologies on our site renaissanceeyewear.fr.
cookies.whatIsText: A cookie is a small text file placed on your computer, tablet or smartphone when you visit a website. Cookies allow the site to recognize your device and remember your actions and preferences over a period of time.
cookies.whyText: We use cookies for several reasons:
whyItems: To ensure the technical functioning of the site
To remember your preferences (language, currency, items in the cart)
To analyze traffic and site usage
cookies.essentialText: These cookies are essential for the site to work properly. They let you browse the site and use its basic features.
essentialItems: Session cookies for logging in to your account
cookies.essentialDuration: Retention period: Session (deleted when the browser is closed) or up to 30 days.
cookies.personalizationText: These cookies store details about your actions to personalize your next visit to the website.
cookies.advertisingText: These cookies are used to optimize commercial communications and show you ads on other sites.
advertisingItems: Ad retargeting cookies (Facebook Pixel, Google Ads)
cookies.analyticsText: These cookies help us understand how you interact with the site. We use this data to identify areas for improvement.
analyticsItems: Google Analytics (traffic analysis, pages visited, visit duration)
cookies.thirdPartyText: Some cookies are placed by third-party services we use:
cookies.shopifyText: Our online store is hosted on Shopify. For more information about Shopify cookies, see: https://www.shopify.com/legal/cookies
cookies.googleAnalyticsText: We use Google Analytics to analyze the use of our site. For more information: Google Privacy Policy
cookies.socialText: Cookies may be placed by social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook) when you interact with our social content.
cookies.manageTitle: How to Manage Your Cookie Preferences?
cookies.bannerText: On your first visit, a banner lets you choose which cookies you accept. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the "Manage my cookies" link at the bottom of the page.
cookies.browserText: Most browsers accept cookies automatically by default, but you can change your browser settings to:
browserItems: Be warned before a cookie is placed
instructionsItems: Google Chrome: Menu → Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Cookies and website data
Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions
cookies.gpcText1: Our site recognizes the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal. If you enable this signal in your browser, we will treat it as a valid request to opt out of sharing or targeted advertising.
cookies.gpcText2: To learn more: https://globalprivacycontrol.org/
cookies.consequencesText: Please note that blocking or deleting certain cookies may:
consequencesItems: Prevent access to certain site features
Require you to log in again on each visit
Fail to save your shopping cart
cookies.updateText: We may update this cookie policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons.
cookies.contactText: For any question about our use of cookies, you can contact us:
contactItems: Address: 4 RUE DES METIERS, HETTANGE GRANDE, 57330, France

garantie.title: Warranty & After-Sales Service
garantie.seoDescription: 3-year warranty from Renaissance Eyewear. After-sales service, repairs, care and advice for your glasses. Satisfaction guaranteed.
garantie.warrantyText: All Renaissance products come with a 3-year manufacturer's warranty from the date of purchase, covering manufacturing and material defects.
notCoveredItems: Scratches on the lenses or the coating
Modifications or repairs carried out by an unauthorized third party
Damage caused by exposure to chemicals
garantie.afterSalesText: Our after-sales service is dedicated to ensuring your complete satisfaction and the longevity of your Renaissance glasses.
garantie.warrantyRepairText: If your frame has a defect covered by the warranty:
warrantyRepairItems: Contact us at contact@renaissanceeyewear.com with your order number and photos of the defect
Our team will assess your request within 48h
If the warranty applies, we'll send you a prepaid return label
Return the frame in its original packaging
We'll carry out the repair or replacement within 15 business days
garantie.outOfWarrantyText: For damage not covered by the warranty, we offer a paid repair service:
outOfWarrantyItems: Free quote within 48h of receiving the frame
Fair prices depending on the nature of the repair
Repair time: 2 to 4 weeks depending on complexity
repairTypesItems: Hinge replacement: If your hinges are damaged
Temple straightening: To restore the original shape
Polishing: To bring back the original shine of the metal
Crystal resetting: If a crystal has fallen out
cleaningItems: Use only the microfiber cloth provided with your glasses
For a deeper clean, use lukewarm soapy water
Dry gently with the microfiber cloth
Never use chemicals, alcohol or solvents
storageItems: Always keep your glasses in their case when you're not wearing them
Never set them down lens-side down, to avoid scratches
Avoid prolonged exposure to high temperatures (dashboard, radiator)
Don't leave them in a damp environment
precautionsItems: Always handle your glasses with both hands to preserve the balance of the temples
Don't wear your glasses on your head, it bends the temples
Have your glasses adjusted regularly at an optician
Avoid contact with hairspray, perfume and cosmetics
garantie.opticiansText: Our 250+ partner opticians in France can help you with:
garantie.certificateText: Every Renaissance frame comes with a numbered certificate of authenticity. This document is essential for any warranty or after-sales request. Keep it safe with your purchase invoice.
garantie.contactText: Our after-sales team is at your service:
garantie.qualityText1: Renaissance is committed to making products of high quality. Every frame is made by hand in Korea by skilled makers and undergoes rigorous quality controls before shipping.
garantie.qualityText2: If, despite all our precautions, you have a problem with your frame, we'll do everything we can to resolve it quickly and to your complete satisfaction.

guideTailles.title: Size Guide
guideTailles.seoDescription: Find the Renaissance Eyewear frame that fits your face. A guide to dimensions, face shapes and tips for choosing your glasses.
guideTailles.heroDescription: A complete guide to understanding the dimensions of our frames and choosing the one that fits your face.
guideTailles.lensWidthDesc: Horizontal width of one lens, measured at its widest point.
guideTailles.bridgeDesc: Distance between the two lenses, at the bridge of the nose.
guideTailles.templesDesc: Length of the temples, from the hinge to the tip.
guideTailles.standardFormatDesc: Our dimensions are shown in this format:
guideTailles.sizeSDesc: Ideal for slim faces and delicate features.
guideTailles.sizeMDesc: The most common size, suits most faces.
guideTailles.sizeLDesc: For wide faces and larger builds.
guideTailles.ovalAdvice: The most balanced shape. All frame shapes suit you. Go for models that are neither too big nor too small to keep the proportions.
guideTailles.roundAdvice: Go for rectangular or geometric frames to slim the face. Avoid shapes that are too round, which would emphasize the roundness.
guideTailles.squareAdvice: Round or oval frames soften angular features. Butterfly shapes are especially flattering.
guideTailles.rectangularAdvice: Choose frames with a tall lens height to visually shorten the face. Hexagonal shapes work well.
guideTailles.ctaDescription: Visit one of our partner opticians to try our collections and get personalized advice.
